about: Canada prices are Statistics Canada table 18-10-0245-01, Canada average, August 2026. United States prices are Bureau of Labor Statistics CPI average prices, U.S. city average, September 2026. Mexico prices are Profeco Quién es Quién en los Precios observations for Mexico City, October 2026. A line that is part of a published package, or a whole number of pounds, keeps the published rate. No price was lowered to fit a cap.
